question: How do the frozen Phase 5 multi-head model and the bim_bridge_v0 chain behave on a few CubiCasa5K test plans and on AI-generated plans, from masks to IFC files, and how much do automated bridge repairs recover?

label_status.cubicasa_test: CubiCasa5K dataset labels (wall_region_mask_path and door_opening_raw_mask_path reproduce the upstream per-image metrics exactly)
label_status.ai_generated: DRAFT labels made by an AI assistant, 0 of 12 images reviewed by a person: scores are agreement with draft labels, not verified accuracy

thin_wall_analysis.note: Computed in the working session of 2026-10-06 from the saved masks and draft labels (512 grid). The cap is the IoU a prediction would score if its only error were 1 px on each wall edge.

rules: R1 collinear merge across mask-supported gaps
R2 end extension along the mask (body-width support, 40 px per end in total, stops at parallel neighbours)
R3 recentre (orthogonal snap, mask centreline, max 3 px)

superseded_revisions.r02 (repair_v1.0): overlapping collinear duplicates left behind; 3 plans failed the input contract
superseded_revisions.r03 (repair_v1.1): slope drift on merged walls and compounding extensions; cc-03 and img-04 regressed

not_measured: No human review of the 15 plans; every IFC is CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED.
No scale: 0.01 preview metres per source pixel, ASSUMED_FOR_PREVIEW.
Windows: not exported in r01 and r04; exported in r05 (2026-10-08) as apertures with an assumed vertical profile. Window heights are not measured.
Windows 'found' uses the same loose one-pixel touch rule as doors: a detection count, not a shape score.

preview_profile.name: pilot_preview_profile_v1
preview_profile.note: Sill and height of the window profile are visualization assumptions chosen by the AI assistant in the working session; nobody confirmed them. They are labelled as assumptions on every exported object, like the door values.

rule.hosting: every head in heads.aperture_heads with a vertical profile is hosted by the r04 host rule; heads without a profile stay recorded and unexported
rule.overlap_same_head: unchanged: both components left unexported as ambiguous
rule.overlap_different_heads: the earlier head in aperture_heads (door_opening) keeps its void; the window is trimmed to stop 0.5 px short of it (recorded as an automated edit), or left unexported when the door covers it or would split it; smallest span kept 2.0 px
rule.why_a_gap: two voids that merely touch fail the input contract's 1e-9 m overlap test after offset and width are rounded separately (the first cc-01 export attempt failed this way; its validation report is kept)

window_components_not_exported.reason: no candidate wall hosts this component

no candidate wall hosts this component

comparison_script_change.what: IFC openings are read with their PredictedClass property and split into door and window sets before any door metric is computed; new window columns

regression_check.what: the r04 exports re-scored with the comparison script after the change (openings split by PredictedClass)
regression_check.note: img-04..06 were not included in the check run; the 12 plans compared cover both run directories
